extra.reason: Verified on hardware: station foxhunt -s works. The apparent ~1/4 success rate was quiet stations, not a bug -- a client only yields RSSI when it transmits (unlike an AP's continuous beacons). Instrumentation (MM-FOX) confirmed correct args + RSSI stream once the station was active.
Verified on-device: quiet station shows 'Waiting for TX...'; readings gain a 'stale Ns' marker when the station goes idle and clear when it resumes.
Verified on-device: Info-level log is quiet during Fox Hunt; rx[] dump now Debug-only.

Implemented and verified on-device: continuous scan with resolve-on-tap works; tapping an AP resolves then opens detail, station list shows clients, station Fox Hunt works. Fixed a store-wipe regression: scene_manager_next_scene calls on_exit on forward push, so the on_exit store reset wiped stations the detail/list scenes needed. Replaced with a scan_resume_pending flag; on_exit no longer wipes.

Shipped & verified on-device: auto-join reads networks.txt (FlipperFormat SSID/Pass), per-join 'Save for later?' confirm scene banks typed passwords, clean Join result screen shows Connecting/Connected/Failed while suppressing Marauder's settings dump (never displays the plaintext password), and a '* Connected (joined)' indicator marks the joined AP. Marauder has no disconnect command (only reboot), so indicator-only per user choice. Host tests cover the join parsers incl. password suppression.
Verified on-device: parsed Device Info screen works.

Verified on-device: protocol category menu (Device Info/WiFi/BT/GPS/System) works; BT greys to '(no HW)' on the S2; WiFi/GPS/System sections and name-based Scripts/Save routing all function; fixed a launch NULL-deref by moving first-scene launch after UART init.

Fixed by switching Host Scan from pingscan to arpscan: much faster, streams bare active IPs live. Verified on-device: 'found a whole bunch of stuff'. (Known follow-up: IPs aren't resolved to MACs / no per-host actions yet.)

Port scan integrated as a per-host action off Host Scan: selecting a host runs 'portscan -t <ipList index> -a'. The old no-op was passing a literal IP; firmware wants the ipList index (confirmed in CommandLine.cpp), which matches our display order since arpscan clears+repopulates ipList per scan. Verified on-device: returns 'IP: Port' lines (e.g. 192.168.0.101: 22). Results are raw console for now.
Verified on-device: parsed screen shows open ports with service names (22 SSH, 443 HTTPS, 5000 DSM) and live progress.
Join WiFi (saved) row removed; joining lives at AP Detail -> Join
Removed on-device log viewer (scene + routing deleted) and raw System>Info; Device Info is the parsed superset
Removed on-device log viewer (scene + routing deleted) and raw System>Info; Device Info is the parsed superset
LED picker, Settings toggle screen (live + Save/Load profile), Reboot confirm, SD Card sub-menu all shipped; verified SD greying + reboot on-device. LED-on-Flipper-board needs firmware (mm-82m).

Deauth monitor implemented: parsed sniffdeauth flows deduped by src->dst, sorted noisiest-first, in Detect. Format source-exact + host-tested. Builds clean; on-device verify pending (user away from device).
